sections.title: Milwaukee Industry Specializations
sections.description: Deep expertise in Milwaukee's key industry verticals.

blocks.heading: Manufacturing Technology (Milwaukee's Dominant AI Market)
paragraphs: Milwaukee is one of the US's most important industrial technology cities — Rockwell Automation (Milwaukee HQ, world's largest pure-play industrial automation company), Johnson Controls International (Milwaukee HQ, building automation and HVAC), Regal Rexnord (Beloit, WI HQ), and Generac Power Systems (Waukesha HQ). Plus the manufacturing base they serve: industrial machinery, precision metal fabrication, food and beverage processing, and automotive components.

Rockwell Automation ecosystem: Rockwell's FactoryTalk AI and Connected Enterprise platform creates an AI ecosystem across Milwaukee's manufacturing customer base. ClickMasters builds commercial AI applications complementing Rockwell's industrial automation platform:
Computer vision quality inspection for manufacturing lines using Rockwell's ControlLogix PLC infrastructure.
Predictive maintenance ML from Rockwell's Connected Enterprise sensor data.
OT/IT integration for AI applications accessing both Rockwell SCADA and enterprise IT data.

Food and beverage manufacturing: Milwaukee's brewing and food processing heritage — Molson Coors (Milwaukee), Palermo's Pizza, and the broader Wisconsin food manufacturing community. Computer vision for food product inspection, process optimization AI, and demand forecasting for seasonal food products.

Precision manufacturing: Milwaukee's machine tool and precision manufacturing community. Computer vision dimensional inspection, predictive maintenance from CNC machine sensor data, and process quality prediction.

blocks.heading: Healthcare
paragraphs: Froedtert Hospital, Aurora Health Care (Milwaukee HQ, 36+ hospitals in Wisconsin), and Children's Wisconsin. HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Milwaukee's health systems:
Patient risk stratification with Epic integration (Froedtert and Aurora both use Epic).
Clinical documentation AI for Milwaukee's large hospital organizations.
Revenue cycle optimization for Aurora's multi-facility health system.

blocks.heading: Financial Services and Insurance
paragraphs: Northwestern Mutual (Milwaukee HQ, one of the US's largest life insurance and financial advisory companies) and Johnson Financial Group. AI for insurance underwriting, investment analytics, and customer lifecycle prediction:
Life insurance risk scoring and underwriting automation for Northwestern Mutual.
Financial advisory analytics for wealth management operations.
Customer attrition prediction for Milwaukee's insurance community.

sections.title: Industrial AI Technical Context for Milwaukee
sections.description: Milwaukee's manufacturing AI requirements reflect Rockwell Automation's ecosystem.

blocks.heading: FactoryTalk Integration
paragraphs: Rockwell's FactoryTalk Historian stores time-series process data that feeds predictive maintenance ML. ClickMasters designs ML pipelines connecting to FactoryTalk's data infrastructure — reading historian data for feature engineering without requiring replacement of Rockwell infrastructure.

blocks.heading: Ethernet/IP and CIP
paragraphs: Rockwell's industrial protocols (Ethernet/IP and CIP) govern communication with ControlLogix PLCs. ClickMasters designs ML integration at the IT layer above PLC-level control — reading process data through OPC-UA or FactoryTalk gateway without directly interfacing with safety-critical control systems.

blocks.heading: Wisconsin Manufacturing Context
paragraphs: Wisconsin's manufacturing community is conservative, safety-first, and pragmatic. ClickMasters designs Milwaukee manufacturing AI with these values — gradual implementation, safety-critical design, and ROI-first prioritization that resonates with Midwest manufacturing culture.
